description: Increases front door sill height to 1.3 meters in older areas.
Increases allowable sidewall area by 10%, exempting some sections.
Reinstates size limit for second story of garage suites.

chips.text: Councillor Derek stated the sidewall area rule is "overly restrictive
Home Builders Association supported changes but felt they didn't go far enough for smaller lots.
Minor variances are not allowed for sidewall calculations due to the Development Act.
Administration committed to providing clearer language in the final bylaw draft.
